summary.question: Of a large, unchosen sample of official Lean declarations, how many does axeyum's kernel admit, and for each decline, which declaration fails first and in which blocker cluster?

producer.exporter_build_note: Cloned into references/ (gitignored) at the pinned commit and built with `lake build` under the pinned toolchain. Verified byte-identical to the committed corpus: re-exporting Nat.add_comm reproduced artifacts/lean-imports/nat-add-comm.ndjson's sha256 cf186612... exactly.
producer.license: Apache-2.0 (lean4export and the Lean 4 core library it exports)

population.note: Init alone holds 40,812 non-internal declarations (enumerated this run); the sample frame is Init+Std so it is directly comparable to the 2026-08-15 scale census.

A/initstd-500-restream.provenance: The IDENTICAL 500 export streams the 2026-08-15 scale census ran, preserved at /nas3/data/axeyum/lean-import-scale/initstd-500-streams. Same bytes, new kernel: a controlled before/after, not a fresh draw.

B/initstd-1000-fresh.provenance: Fresh uniform sample of the same 96,591-name frame, drawn at seed 20260817 and filtered to be DISJOINT from sample A. Exported individually at the pinned exporter commit.

bounds.parallel_pass: 6 jobs, 120 s wall, 8 GB address space, 512 MB census stack
bounds.serial_recheck: 2 jobs, 300 s wall, 16 GB address space
bounds.recheck_scope: every declaration the parallel pass classified RESOURCE (18)
bounds.recheck_finding: 3 of 18 became CLEAN with the larger budget, so the parallel pass OVER-REPORTS the RESOURCE class. `adjudicated` carries the re-checked verdict; `outcome` carries the parallel one.

export_failed_declarations.cause: EXPORTER-side, not importer-side. `lean4export`'s CLI decodes each requested name with `Syntax.decodeNameLit`, which returns none for notation names; the binary PANICs to stderr and still EXITS 0 with a metadata-only stream. Reproduced this run for `term_^_` and `stx_,*`.

negative_control.why: A census reporting zero declines is the exact shape of a checker that cannot fail, so the binary was shown to still report one.
negative_control.method: One token changed in stream 8 of sample A: a `thm` record's `value` expression id repointed at its own `type` id (1502 -> 1462).
negative_control.mutated: records=124 admitted_records=118 declines=6 — root `Int.decNonneg._proof_1` DeclarationValueMismatch, plus 5 UnknownConst cascades.

pilot_corpus_recheck.note: This is the corpus the 2026-08-15 pilot reported as 13/40. Every named representative of all four pilot clusters is in it and now imports: eq_of_heq (HEq), Nat.pow_succ (rfl-equation), List.nil_append and Nat.succ_sub_succ (other type mismatches), and the `._f`/brecOn auxiliaries inside the Nat closures.

prior_root_blockers_retired.source: the 2026-08-15 scale census's six distinct roots
prior_root_blockers_retired.not_re_run: _private.Std.Data.DTreeMap.Internal.Zipper.0.…prependMap.eq_def — a `_private` name; its sample-A stream is CLEAN this run, which covers it.

reproduce.export: cd references/lean4export && lake env ./.lake/build/bin/lean4export Init Std -- <Declaration> > stream.ndjson
